newpipe_playerservice_bind.cause_chain: Same-thread same-millisecond sequence immediately precedes the wrapped exception on BOTH boards (5cd tid 29970 @10:18:11.690; 61b tid 31683 @09:53:32.795): BMS 'GET_BUNDLE_INFO_PRIVILEGED ... denied' -> BMSQuery 'GetBundleInfo fail -n android -u 100 -f 4160' -> OHBundleMgrClient 'GetBundleInfo failed for: android' -> OH_PMAdapter 'getPackageInfo: not found: android' -> next ms '[B8-AMB] in-process bind failed for ...PlayerService: java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException'.
newpipe_playerservice_bind.inner_cause: InvocationTargetException.getCause() is NOT printed by [B8-AMB], but the immediate precursor is a hard PackageManager.getPackageInfo("android") NameNotFound on the same app thread. PlayerService extends androidx.media.MediaBrowserServiceCompat; onCreate builds a MediaSessionCompat which resolves platform/media-button package info via getPackageInfo. The OH BMS adapter does not synthesize the framework 'android' package and denies GET_BUNDLE_INFO_PRIVILEGED -> NameNotFoundException -> wrapped as InvocationTargetException by the reflective in-process bind.
